content: Sɑnɑm mɛ sɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ te bɑnɑ sɑ kpɑ sɑ ten ɡɑmbobɑ doke, yerɑ sɑ be bɑ rɑ kɔnnɔsu kɔ̃su doke ben sɔmɑ sɔɔ kɑ sere mɑɑ wom kowobu kɑ Lefi be bɑ tie.
Mɑ nɑ nɛn mɔɔ Hɑnɑni woodɑ wɛ̃ u Yerusɑlɛmu kpɑrɑ, wi kɑ Hɑnɑniɑ, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmun ɡbɑ̃rɑ kɔ̃sobun wiruɡii. Durɔ wi, u tɔn be bɑ tie kere. Domi u sɑ̃ɑ nɑɑnɛɡii mɑ u Gusunɔ nɑsie.

Nɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, bɑ ǹ Yerusɑlɛmun kɔnnɔsu kɛniɑmɔ mɑ n kun mɔ sɔ̃ɔ u yɑrɑ. Yokɑ bɑ koo su kɛnɛwɑ kɔnnɔ kɔ̃sobu bu sere doonɑ. Yen biru, bɑ koo Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu bikiɑ bu wuu kɔ̃su, ben bɑɑwure u n yɔ̃ win dii kɔnnɔwɔ.
Yuu be bɑ wurɑ ben temɔ
Bɑɑ mɛ Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ kpɑ̃, yɑ mɑɑ yɑsu, yen tɔmbu bɑ ǹ dɑbi, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ diɑ bɑnɛ.

Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u doke nɛn ɡɔ̃ruɔ n bukurobu mɛnnɑ kɑ siri kowobu kɑ wuun tɔmbu n kɑ bu ɡɑri ɡɑri. Mɑ nɑ tireru ɡɑru wɑ tè sɔɔ bɑ tɔmbun yĩsɑ yoruɑ nɡe mɛ ben bɑɑwuren bweserun tɔ̃kɑ sɑ̃ɑ. Berɑ be bɑ ɡbiɑ bɑ wurɑmɑ Bɑbilonin di. Ye nɑ wɑ bɑ yoruɑ wee.
Tɔn be Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u yoru mwɛɛrɑ u kɑ dɑ win mi, ben dɑbiru tɑ wurɑmɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ Yudɑn temɔ. Mɑ ben bɑɑwure u dɑ win wuuɔ.
Wee be bɑ tɔn be kpɑrɑmɑ. Berɑ Sorobɑbɛli kɑ Yosue kɑ Nɛɛmi kɑ Asɑriɑ kɑ Rɑmiɑ kɑ Nɑkɑmɑni kɑ Mɑɑdose kɑ Bilisɑni kɑ Misipɑɑ kɑ Biɡifɑi kɑ Nɛhumu kɑ Bɑɑnɑ. Tɔn ben ɡeeru kɑ ben bwese kɛrin yĩsɑ wee.
Pɑreɔsin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru kɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (2.172).
Sefɑtiɑn bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (372).
Arɑn bweseru sɔɔ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ yiru (652).
Pɑkɑti Mɔɑbun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru kɑ nɛnɛ kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ itɑ (2.818). Bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yosue kɑ Yoɑbun sikɑdominu.
Elɑmun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ ɡoobu kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ nnɛ (1.254).
Sɑtun bweseru sɔɔ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɛnɛ kɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbu (845).
Sɑkɑin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɑtɑ (760).
Binuin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbɑ itɑ (648).
Bebɑin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu kɑ itɑ (628).
Asiɡɑdin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru kɑ ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ yɛndɑ yiru (2.322).
Adonikɑmun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wɑtɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru (667).
Biɡifɑin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru kɑ wɑtɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru (2.067).
Adinin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ nɔɔbu (655).
Atɛɛn bweseru sɔɔ, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Esekiɑsin yɛnuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɔbu yiru sɑri.
Hɑsumun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu kɑ itɑ (328).
Bɛsɑin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ yɛndɑ nnɛ (324).
Hɑrifun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɔbu kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (112).
Gɑbɑoniɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wɛnɛ kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu (95).
Bɛtelehɛmuɡibu kɑ Nɛtofɑɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ wɛnɛ kɑ nɔɔbɑ itɑ (188).
Anɑtɔtuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ teeru kɑ nɔɔbɑ itɑ (128).
Bɛti Asimɑfɛtiɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu weeru kɑ yiru (42).
Kiriɑti Yɑrimu kɑ Kefirɑɡibu kɑ Beerɔtuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɑɑ weeru kɑ itɑ (743).
Rɑmɑɡibu kɑ Gebɑɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ yɛndɑ tiɑ (621).
Mikimɑsiɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ teeru kɑ yiru (122).
Betɛliɡibu kɑ Ayiɡibu bɑ kuɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ teeru kɑ itɑ (123).
Nɛbo yeɔnɔɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu weerɑɑkuru kɑ yiru (52).
Elɑmu wiɔnɔn yɛnuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ ɡoobu kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ nnɛ (1.254).
Hɑrimun yɛnuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ yɛndu (320).
Yerikoɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbu (345).
Loduɡibu kɑ Hɑdidiɡibu kɑ Onɔɔɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɑɑ teeru kɑ tiɑ (721).
Senɑɑɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ itɑ kɑ nɛnɛ kɑ wunɑɑ teeru kɑ wɔkuru (3.930).
Wee tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowobun bweseru sɔɔ. Yosuen bweseru sɔɔ, Yedɑyɑn yɛnuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛnɛ kɑ wunɑɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ itɑ (973)
Imɛrin yɛnuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ yiru (1.052).
Pɑsurin yɛnuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ ɡoobu kɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru (1.247).
Hɑrimun yɛnuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ yiru (1.017).
Lefibɑn wuuru sɔɔ, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yosue kɑ Kɑdimiɛlin bweseru, Hodifɑn sikɑdominu, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ nnɛ (74).
Asɑfun yɛnuɡii be bɑ rɑ womu ko sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbɑ itɑ (148).
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑrun kɔnnɔ kɔ̃sobu bɑ kɑ sɑ̃ɑ Sɑlumun yɛnuɡibu kɑ Atɛɛbɑ kɑ Tɑlumɔɔbɑ kɑ Akububɑ kɑ Hɑtitɑbɑ kɑ sere Sobɑibɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ weeru yiru sɑri (138).
Nɛtinibɑn bweseru sɔɔ, be bɑ rɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun sɔmburu ko ben sikɑdobɑrɑ Sihɑ kɑ Hɑsufɑ kɑ Tɑbɑɔtu
kɑ Kɛrɔsi kɑ Siɑ kɑ Pɑdoni
kɑ Lebɑnɑ kɑ Hɑɡɑbɑ kɑ Sɑlumɑi
kɑ Hɑnɑnu kɑ Gidɛli kɑ Gɑsɑɑri
kɑ Reɑyɑ kɑ Resini kɑ Nɛkodɑ
kɑ Gɑsɑmu kɑ Usɑ kɑ Pɑseɑki
kɑ Besɑi kɑ Mɛhunimu kɑ Nɛfisimu
kɑ Bɑkibuki kɑ Hɑkufɑ kɑ Hɑɑhuru
kɑ Bɑsiliti kɑ Mɛhidɑ kɑ Hɑɑsɑ
kɑ Bɑɑkɔsi kɑ Siserɑ kɑ Tɑmɑki
kɑ Nɛtisɑ kɑ Hɑtifɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Sɑlomɔɔn sɔm kowobun bibun sikɑdobɑ, berɑ Sotɑi kɑ Soferɛti kɑ Peridɑ
kɑ Yɑɑlɑ kɑ Dɑɑkoni kɑ Gidɛli
kɑ Sefɑtiɑ kɑ Hɑtili kɑ Pokerɛti Hɑsebɑimu kɑ Amɔɔ.
Nɛtini be, kɑ Sɑlomɔɔn sɔm kowobun bii be, be kpuro bɑ kuɑwɑ mi tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɛnɛ kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (392).

Be bɑ yoru wɔmɑ sɑɑ Tɛli Mɛlɑkin di kɑ Tɛli Hɑsɑɑn di kɑ Kerubu Adonin di kɑ Imɛrin di bɑ ǹ kpĩɑ bɑ ben tundon yɛnu ɡie, bɑ ǹ mɑɑ kpĩɑ bɑ ben bweserun tɔ̃kɑ wunɑnɛ bu kɑ sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ ben tii bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Isirelibɑ.
Ben wiruɡibɑ Delɑyɑ kɑ Tobiyɑ kɑ Nɛkodɑ. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ weeru kɑ yiru (642).

Yɑ̃ku kowobu sɔɔ, ɡɑbɑ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ be bɑ ǹ kpĩɑ bɑ ben bweserun tɔ̃kɑ wunɑnɛ. Berɑ Hobɑyɑn bibun bweseru kɑ Hɑkɔtuɡiru kɑ Bɑɑsilɑiɡiru. Bɑ bwese te sokɑ Bɑɑsilɑi yèn sɔ̃ ben sikɑdo u Bɑɑsilɑi Gɑlɑdiɡiin bii wɔndiɑ suɑ kurɔ.
Berɑ bɑ ben bweserun tɔ̃kɑ kɑsu bɑ biɑ. Mɑ bɑ bu yɑrɑ yɑ̃ku sɔmburun di.
Mɑ tem mɛn kpɑro u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, mɑ n kun mɔ yɑ̃ku kowo ɡoo u kpĩɑ u bikiɑru kuɑ kɑ urimu kɑ tumimu ben ɡoo kun yɑ̃ku dĩɑnu dimɔ.
Tɔn be kpuron ɡeeru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ weeru kɑ yiru kɑ ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɑtɑ (42.360)

ben sɔm kowobu bɑɑsi. Ben sɔm kowo ben ɡeeru wee, tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑ ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru (7.337). Be sɔɔ, wom kowobu ɡoobu kɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbu (245) bɑ wɑ̃ɑ tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu. Ben dumin ɡeerɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɑtɑ kɑ wunɑɑ teeru kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ tiɑ (736) kɑ sere birɑkɔsu ɡoobu kɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbu (245)
kɑ yooyoosu nɛɛru kɑ tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbu (435) kɑ sere kɛtɛkunu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ kɑ nɑtɑ kɑ wunɑɑ teeru (6.720).

Yɛnu yɛ̃robu dɑbinɑ bɑ kɛ̃nu kuɑ bɑnɑ yen sɔ̃. Wee ye tem mɛn kpɑro u mɑɑ wɛ̃ bɑnɑ yen sɔ̃. U wurɑn ɡobi nɔrɔbu (1.000) wɛ̃ kɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛnu weerɑɑkuru ni bɑ koo kɑ yɑɑ yɛm yɛ̃kɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku kowobun tɑkobɑ nɛɛrɑ wunɔbu kɑ tɛnɑ (530).
Yɛnu yɛ̃ro ben kɛ̃ɛ ni bɑ kuɑ nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ wurɑn ɡobi nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndu (20.000) kɑ sii ɡeesu kilo nɔrɔbu kɑ wunɔbu (1.100).
Tɔn be bɑ tie bɑ mɑɑ wurɑn ɡobi nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndu (20.000) wɛ̃ kɑ sii ɡeesu kilo nɔrɔbu (1.000) kɑ sere yɑ̃ku kowobun tɑkobɑ wɑtɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru.

Yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ kɑ ɡbɑ̃rɑ kɔnnɔ kɔ̃sobu kɑ wom kowobu kɑ Nɛtinibɑ kɑ sere Isireli be bɑ tie ben bɑɑwure u wurɑwɑ win wuuɔ. Ɛsidɑrɑsi u woodɑn tireru ɡɑrɑ bɑtumɑ sɔɔ Wɔ̃ɔn suru nɔɔbɑ yirusen tɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikiru sɔɔ, Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ben wusɔ.

footnotes.text: (245) - Ɛsidɑrɑsin tireru sɔɔ, 2:66, bɑ nɛɛ, bɑ dumi 736 kɑ birɑkɔsu 245 mɔ. Adɑmɑ Nɛɛmin tireru sɔɔ, bɑ ǹ ye yoruɑ.
